/*kr.happy.study.asset.inbound.dao.InboundDao.getNextProductNo*/
SELECT @new_product_no := CASE WHEN current_max IS NULL THEN 'a'
WHEN LENGTH(current_max) = 1 AND current_max < 'z' THEN CHAR(ASCII(current_max) + 1)
WHEN LENGTH(current_max) = 1 AND current_max = 'z' THEN 'aa'
WHEN LENGTH(current_max) = 2 THEN CASE WHEN RIGHT(current_max, 1) < 'z' THEN CONCAT(LEFT(current_max, 1), CHAR(ASCII(RIGHT(current_max, 1)) + 1))
WHEN RIGHT(current_max, 1) = 'z' AND LEFT(current_max, 1) < 'z' THEN CONCAT(CHAR(ASCII(LEFT(current_max, 1)) + 1), 'a')
WHEN current_max = 'zz' THEN 'aaa' END END FROM ( SELECT CASE
WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_product_info WHERE LENGTH(product_no) >= 2 AND product_no REGEXP '^[a-z]+$') THEN (SELECT MAX(product_no) FROM tb_product_info WHERE LENGTH(product_no) >= 2 AND product_no REGEXP '^[a-z]+$')
ELSE (SELECT MAX(product_no) FROM tb_product_info WHERE LENGTH(product_no) = 1 AND product_no REGEXP '^[a-z]+$') END AS current_max ) t
